title: Two misses in a row: one text today, a new angle, never silence or guilt

history.text: Kalimera Sam! Chapter 4 of Atomic Habits at 10 tonight, in bed. You said you'd do it and I know you will. You in?
Still here, Sam. Ten pages before bed, you've got this.

plan.reason: A few pages before sleep builds the habit without a big ask.

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: no case covered the one-a-day text after two misses.
shouldHaveHappened: Exactly one text ZOH starts today, at its usual time (it may come close to the 10 pm step): warm, with Sam's name, sincere and without guilt, and from a new angle rather than another push like the last ones (a different reason, a smaller start, or an open question about what's getting in the way). It names today's step. No second, third or follow-up text the rest of the day.
